summary.text: Heath Sessions is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 46 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is a business executive from Rock Hill.

paragraphs.text: Heath Sessions was born in Spartanburg, South Carolina, and lives in Rock Hill, South Carolina.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of South Carolina, and his career experience includes working as vice president of a local land clearing contractor.
Sessions has served on the Historic Rock Hill Board and the Camp Canaan Board.
He assumed office on November 14, 2022, succeeding Gary Simrill.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee.
The Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
